name: Necrotic Resurrection
notes: In game (hwp_pri_necrotic_resurrection, tested): aim at an intact body within 150; a channel under a raising buff that silences you (3 s, 5 s for an elite's body, 10 s for a boss's) then raises a copy of the enemy on your team with its own skills, at 50/60/70/85/100% of its health and damage, up to 2/2/3/3/4 risen (past the cap the oldest dies); a risen has at least 120 health (a 60-health wasp died to one brute in two seconds), and one that cannot move (the heavy ballista) loses its minimum range. Heresy +1 normal, +2 elite, +3 boss; refused at 5 Heresy. Mana 70 and the 20 s cooldown are spent when the channel completes (a cancelled channel costs nothing); Heresy comes with the host's answer. Risen health decays 1% every 3 s (9 s for a boss) and never heals; they teleport back to you like other summons when 350 away. Every one of the 141 raisable enemies and the 10 non-final bosses raised and checked by plan-forgemaster 20261022-102006 and plan-forgemaster-bosses 20261022-144616 (bosses at 3000-8000 health, their arena-only skills stripped). Assumed: the 150 raise range, the channel times, the decay rate, the boss health caps, the 120 health floor, the 60 s a body lasts. 2026-10-25 (built, fix-forgemaster-channels): the channel locks the priest onto the body (faces it, rotation locked, the Dash refused until it ends), a green necrotic beam runs from the priest to the body widening as it channels with a pulse on the body every 150 ms, and a 'Raising' progress bar is drawn over the priest.
summary: Reanimate an intact body left by Call of Heresy as a loyal summon that fights for you. Their health decays slowly over time. Each summon adds Heresy: 1 for a normal enemy, 2 for an elite, 3 for a boss; at 5 Heresy you can no longer raise the dead. At max Divine Favor the skill becomes Sacrificial Penance: channel for 3 seconds to sacrifice an intact body and remove Heresy.
